主要内容: DISH Network Corporation appointed Kathleen Q. Abernathy as an independent member of its Board of Directors effective March 7, 2019. Ms. Abernathy was appointed following the recommendation of the Nominating Committee and will serve on the Audit and Executive Compensation Committees. She previously served as Executive Vice President, External Affairs for Frontier Communications Inc. and as Chief Legal Officer. The Board determined that Ms. Abernathy meets the independence requirements of NASDAQ and SEC rules due to her regulatory and managerial experience in the telecommunications industry. This appointment reflects the company's ongoing efforts to strengthen its governance structure and leverage her expertise in regulatory and corporate affairs. The change is specific to the company and does not involve broader industry or market implications at this time.
